verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy is the father of Rory McIlroy.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'is the son of Rosie and Gerry McIlroy'; R3: 'Who is Rory McIlroy’s dad, Gerry McIlroy?'; R6: 'Rory's beloved mum and dad'; R7: 'His father, Gerry McIlroy'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Gerry is Rory's father.

verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy is a four-time major champion.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R7: Lists 6 major wins (2011 U.S. Open, 2012 PGA, 2014 Open, 2014 PGA, 2025 Masters, 2026 Masters)

verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy is a working-class man from Northern Ireland.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'from Northern Ireland'; R3: 'I am a working-class man'; R4: 'I am a working-class man'; R6: 'working-class man'
verifications.reasoning: Direct quotes and statements confirm both attributes.

verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy worked multiple jobs including as a bartender at Holywood Golf Club.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'worked as a bartender at Holywood Golf Club'; R4: 'From 12pm to 6pm I was a bartender at Holywood Golf Club'; R6: 'From 12-6pm I was a bartender at Holywood Golf Club'; R7: 'served as a bartender at Holywood Golf Club'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly mentions bartending at Holywood Golf Club among multiple jobs.

verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy introduced Rory McIlroy to golf at age two.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R7: 'introduced to golf at a young age by his father and received a set of plastic clubs when he was two years old'; R2: 'first introduced him to the sport... received his first plastic golf club when he was 21 months old'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly link father introducing golf with plastic clubs at age two.

verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy coached Rory McIlroy until he was 17.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Gerry coached Rory and caddied for him... caddied for McIlroy until he was 17'; R3: 'Gerry coached Rory and caddied'; R6: 'caddied for him until he was 17'
verifications.reasoning: Coaching mentioned early on, caddying until 17; coaching duration not precisely until 17.

verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy grew up in public housing outside Belfast.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'grew up in public housing outside Belfast'; R6: 'grew up in public housing outside Belfast'

verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy played golf at a scratch-handicap level.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'played at a scratch-handicap level'; R6: 'played at a scratch-handicap level'; R7: 'played at a scratch handicap level'

verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy worked 100-hour weeks including cleaning toilets and bartending to pay for expensive tournament fees.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'worked 100 hours per week to fund Rory's participation'; R7: 'worked 100 hours a week; he cleaned toilets... bartender'; R3: 'cleaned toilets... bartender'
verifications.reasoning: Matches hours, jobs, and purpose exactly.

verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy said it was "always Rory's dream, not mine".
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2/R6: Rory said 'It was always my ambition, my dream... I had to drag my dad out'
verifications.reasoning: Quote is from Rory, not Gerry; misattribution.

verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy placed £100 at 500-1 odds that Rory McIlroy would win an Open Championship within 10 years.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R4: 'placed a hardly insignificant £200 bet... £100,000 richer'; friends '£200 at odds of 250/1... £100 was bet at 150/1'
verifications.reasoning: Gerry bet £200 (implying 500-1 for £100k payout), not £100; odds mismatch for his bet.

verifications.claim: Gerry McIlroy won the bet after Rory McIlroy's 2014 victory.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'As the 25-year-old McIlroy... winning... his father suddenly found himself £100,000 richer'
verifications.reasoning: Directly states win after 2014 Open victory.

verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy won an Open Championship in 2014.
